installCommand: echo 'no packages needed: the generator uses only node fs and path'

headers.comment: Media keeps its filename across deploys, so a long cache is safe here.

The stylesheet and script keep their filenames too, so they must NOT be immutable: a browser would hold a stale copy for a year and never revalidate. The build appends a content hash (?v=) so repeat visitors still get a cheap 304 and a new build is always fetched.
Pages are regenerated on every deploy.
